narrative: Today's briefing highlights significant advancements and shifts across technology, AI, and science. Google Assistant is set to be replaced by Gemini, while AI continues to fuel innovation in weather prediction and cybercrime. Space exploration also sees notable progress with NASA's new asteroid-detecting telescope and SpaceX's expansion into terrestrial mobile networks.

highlights.title: Disney gives TikTok creators official access to Marvel, Star Wars, and Pixar characters
highlights.whyItMatters: This partnership signifies a new era of content integration, bringing fan-created short-form videos featuring iconic franchises to Disney Plus.

highlights.title: Google Assistant will disappear from your phone next month
highlights.whyItMatters: The complete transition from Google Assistant to Gemini on Android devices marks a significant shift in Google's AI strategy for mobile.

highlights.title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
highlights.whyItMatters: WindBorne Systems' $37 million funding round highlights the growing investment and potential for AI to revolutionize weather forecasting accuracy and commercial viability.

highlights.title: NASA’s new dark energy space telescope can also detect killer asteroids
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will not only deepen our understanding of the universe but also provide crucial capabilities for planetary defense against asteroids.

highlights.title: SpaceX is coming for T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon
highlights.whyItMatters: SpaceX's initiative to build a terrestrial mobile network signals a major competitive shake-up in the telecommunications industry, leveraging its satellite infrastructure.

highlights.title: AI fuels more than half of cybercrime in Africa as scams surge – Interpol
highlights.whyItMatters: The alarming rise in AI-fueled cybercrime in Africa underscores the urgent need for enhanced cybersecurity measures and international cooperation.

highlights.title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
highlights.whyItMatters: This report highlights the critical challenge of ensuring safety and ethical deployment as powerful open-weight AI models become more accessible and capable.

topics.name: Artificial Intelligence
topics.summary: AI continues to drive innovation, from improving weather predictions to transforming mobile experiences with Gemini, while also presenting challenges in cybersecurity and model safety.

topics.name: Space & Science
topics.summary: Advancements in space technology, including new telescopes and SpaceX's expanding ventures, alongside scientific research, are broadening our understanding of the universe and our planet.

topics.name: Infrastructure & Cloud
topics.summary: The growing demand for data centers is straining power grids, while cloud providers enhance services and security, crucial for supporting the expanding AI landscape.

topics.name: Developer Tools & Open Source
topics.summary: New tools and platforms are emerging to streamline development workflows, particularly for AI agents, alongside initiatives to bolster open-source project sustainability and security.

topics.name: Consumer Technology
topics.summary: Innovations in consumer devices, streaming services, and mobile networks continue to evolve, with AI playing an increasingly central role in personal technology experiences.
